# The ground: the mowed lawn (stripes by column, light and mid green) that the tall grass tiles
# cover, a sandy path round it, soil borders, the two raised flower beds. make_env.py.
new
material new Light --base-color 0.388 0.776 0.302 --no-slot
material new Mid --base-color 0.196 0.451 0.271 --no-slot
material new Sand --base-color 0.722 0.435 0.314 --no-slot
material new Soil --base-color 0.455 0.247 0.224 --no-slot
material new Edge --base-color 0.686 0.749 0.824 --no-slot
material new BedSoil --base-color 0.455 0.247 0.224 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Stripe0_0 --size 1 --location -2.9750 0.0000 -0.0600
scale 0.8500 5.1000 0.1200
apply --scale
material assign Light
add mesh cube --name Stripe1_0 --size 1 --location -2.1250 2.1250 -0.0600
scale 0.8500 0.8500 0.1200
apply --scale
material assign Mid
add mesh cube --name Stripe1_1 --size 1 --location -2.1250 -0.8500 -0.0600
scale 0.8500 3.4000 0.1200
apply --scale
material assign Mid

apply --scale
material assign Light

apply --scale

apply --scale
material assign Light

apply --scale
material assign Light
add mesh cube --name Stripe7_0 --size 1 --location 2.9750 0.0000 -0.0600
scale 0.8500 5.1000 0.1200
apply --scale
material assign Mid
select Stripe0_0 Stripe1_0 Stripe1_1 Stripe2_0 Stripe2_1 Stripe3_0 Stripe4_0 Stripe5_0 Stripe5_1 Stripe6_0 Stripe6_1 Stripe7_0
active Stripe0_0
join

scale 7.9000 0.5500 0.1100

scale 7.9000 0.5500 0.1100

material assign Sand

scale 12.8000 2.1000 0.1400

material assign Soil
